title.zh: 微度假，从酒店门口开始
title.en: The micro-vacation starts at our door

text.zh: 义乌不只有商贸。江畔的落日、老街的烟火、古镇的石板路——这座城市值得多留一天。
text.en: Yiwu is more than a marketplace. Riverside sunsets, old-street lanterns, ancient town stone paths — the city deserves one more day.

description.zh: 全球最大的小商品市场，7.5 万个摊位，180 万种商品。来这里不是购物，是看世界如何运转。
description.en: The world's largest small-commodity market — 75,000 booths, 1.8 million products. Come not to shop, but to watch the world work.

description.zh: 傍晚的江风是这座城市最慷慨的赠予。沿江慢走或骑行，看落日把水面染成琥珀色。
description.en: The evening river breeze is the city's most generous gift. Walk or cycle the riverbank as the sunset turns the water amber.

description.zh: 明清石板街、老商号、手作工坊。穿越六百年的义乌，在午后阳光下慢慢走。
description.en: Ming-Qing stone streets, old merchant houses, artisan workshops. Six hundred years of Yiwu, walked slowly in the afternoon sun.

description.zh: 廿三里茶山、岩口水库、华溪森林公园——义乌的背面，是山、水与茶。
description.en: Tea hills, reservoirs and forest parks — Yiwu's other side is mountains, water and tea.
